1.d4 d5 2.c4 Nc6 3.Nf3 Bg4.name: Queen's Gambit Declined: Chigorin Defence, Main Line

1.d4 d5 2.c4 Nc6 3.Nf3 Bg4 4.Qa4.strategy: Pins the c6 knight against the king, which takes the piece that attacked d4 out of play, and guards the c4 pawn. The queen leaves d1 and stands exposed, but Black has to untangle the pin before the pressure on d4 can resume.
